propositions: The scc metric backend invokes scc without --by-file flag, causing scc to return language summaries with empty Files arrays instead of per-file entries.
_scc_files correctly parses only per-file entries from scc JSON, yielding zero results when Files arrays are empty, preventing metric matches from ever being emitted.

The metric detector rebar.builtin.smell.metric-oversize is documented to flag files exceeding the 800-LOC cutoff but currently emits no matches because the threshold loop never executes with empty file lists.
Adding the --by-file argument to the scc invocation in _metric_invoke restores the contract: present scc runs over files exceeding the cutoff emit normalized metric matches per file.
The fix is a one-argument localized change to the scc command that does not alter threshold logic, Code field handling, or existing fail-open semantics for tool absence or invalid output.
